name: Web Locks and Media Session
plain: Lets a page coordinate tabs and show media controls on the lock screen.
meaning: Media Session exposes title and artwork to OS media UI. Web Locks coordinates work across tabs.

access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

data.metric: Lets a page coordinate tabs and show media controls on the lock screen.

limits.headline: Can coordinate work across your open tabs and show media controls on your lock screen
limits.user_action: You play a podcast or video, or open the same site in two tabs
can: Show the title and artwork in your lock screen and notification controls
Let play and pause buttons from your headphones or keyboard reach the page
Make two tabs of the same site take turns doing a job
cannot: See what other apps are playing
Take over your controls when another app is playing
Learn anything about you from this alone

story.what_it_is: A page can coordinate its own tabs, and show play and pause controls on your lock screen.

marketing.name: Media Session API
marketing.pitch: Lets a page show track info and play controls on the lock screen, headphones and car displays.

story.for_you: You see the song title, picture and play buttons on your lock screen and in your car. Pressing a headphone button pauses the page. Behind the scenes, tabs avoid fighting over the same job.
story.for_makers: Makers get a polished player with lock screen controls and clean tab behavior. Locks stop two tabs doing the same work, such as syncing twice. Both are quiet features that make web apps feel native.

use_cases.example: A web music player shows the song, cover art and skip buttons on your phone lock screen.
A video site shows play, pause and seek controls on the lock screen and a smart watch.
A browser game with sound pauses music when you press pause on your headphones.
A web editor uses locks so only one open tab syncs your document at a time.
A live radio or podcast site shows the show name on the lock screen.
A web player shows track info on a car display when your phone is connected.
A web chat uses locks so only one tab plays the message sound.

technical_bounds: Media Session only for playing media
